6f577af1: If X is blank and DV does not contain 'R', or X is blank and DV is blank, or X is blank and D is not positive, go to label A.
599633f7: If X starts with '?', go to label QS. If X contains '^', execute label D and go to ^DIE17.
57ae3985: If X is '@', execute label D and go to Z^DIE2.

e7af4534: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV does not contain 'P', and the DEFAULT data for the current user, application, and dialog box label exists, set X to the DEFAULT value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the DEFAULT value.

dcea6b6d: If DV is not blank, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to label P. If the Help Text for the current field exists, execute it. If DIC('S') exists, execute it. If DB(DQ) does not exist, write the Help Text. Go to label V.

a517cd35: For each ';' piece of DU: set Y to the piece, set DG to the position of X in Y (delimited by ':'), go to label X if Y is blank, set YS to Y, and set Y to the piece before ':'. If DG is true, execute DIC('S'). If DG is true, quit the loop.
1f44fade: If DB(DQ) does not exist, write the remainder of YS starting from position DG. Set X to the piece of YS before ':'.

7a19260e: If DV contains 'P', set DIC to U_DU, and set DIC(0) based on the existence of DB(DQ) and whether DV contains "'". If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after 'P'. If DV does not contain '*', execute ^DIC. Set X to the value of Y, and set DIC to DIE. Go to label X if X is negative.
5b258b7e: If DV does not contain 'N', execute label D. If the length of the part of X before the decimal point is greater than 24, kill X and go to label Z.

1ce34a5f: If the second piece of DV after ',' is true, X contains '.', and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) after U does not start with '$', perform numeric formatting on X. If the last digit of the part of X after '.' is 0, remove the last digit. If the part of X after '.' is blank and X contains '.', set X to its numeric value.
ac2f712a: Execute the label 'X'_DQ. Kill YS.
3f775737: Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X exists and is not U, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) to X. Go to label A.
325fed56: Write '*7' and '??'. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.
105054d9: Set X to '?BAD'.
2bcb416c: Set DZ to X, execute label D, execute QQ^DIEQ, and go to label B.
58b6a2ae: Set D=DIFLD (field #), DQ(DQ)=DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_$P($T(@("X"_DQ)),...) which stores the field attributes in ^UTILITY nodes.

e2a923aa: If input variable DE(DQ) is undefined, perform output transform on X. If X=@, either perform reader input or go to 'N' label based on DV value. If X=@, go to 'RD' label if DV allows nulls, else go to 'A' label.
49c7afa8: If DQ is defined, set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ) (stored input data), X=DU (»ull¿ value for reader). If DQ(DQ,2) contains code, execute it.

ad279c0b: If DV does not have either INPUT TRANSFORM or COMPUTED-FIELD attributes, go to RD (reader).
9bbce991: Execute INPUT TRANSFORM and if transformed data is returned, go to RD (reader), else go to PR (previous).
